method: Read every module commands/mod.rs::command_specs() aggregates (plus models.rs, storage.rs, learn.rs, templates.rs, ease_presets.rs, preview.rs, session_settings.rs) and followed each run fn into the Session hooks (services/Importer, exporter, script, plugin_loader, config ConfigStore, browser, storage, models_dir) and into raw std::fs / process::Command / Event::OpenUrl / Event::Frontend, using a per-function sink map of the engine crate plus rg over the render-path crates (effects, render, text, media, model, expr, script) and the egui frontend's command handlers. A command whose run is only frontend() is host; one that changes viewer-only display state, app Settings (config store) or process-wide state is host; an advisory frontend event alongside document work does not change the class (headless backends drain and drop events); renders that only decode the open project's footage are safe. Expressions: effectcraft_expr is full JavaScript on boa 0.22 (eval/Function/regex) but strictly I/O-free - its only native host calls read the open project and its footage pixels (host.rs Req::*), with no fs/net/console/module loader - and finitely capped (loop_iteration_limit 10,000,000, recursion_limit 400, <=2000 host-request passes, MAX_DEPTH 16), so expression-setting commands are classified safe (they store text and run a parse-only syntax check; evaluation happens only during rendering and reaches nothing outside the session); the caveat is the caps are coarse with no wall-clock or memory budget (a CPU-DoS, not a reach), flagged for Phase 2. Limits: classes are per id, so parameter-dependent reach (LUT/OCIO effect file-path params set via prop.set, glTF sibling-resource URIs) is flagged in why rather than reclassifying the generic setter; frontend behaviour was read only in crates/ui-egui; nothing was built or run; the line numbers are from the pinned checkout d60cb71.

rules.why: Edit the open project (layers, masks, shapes, paths, paint, puppet, liquify, effects, keyframes, property values and expressions, time, markers, tracking) or query it; no path, device, network, settings or other-command reach.
